The image is ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace contains exactly one view, so there's one image:

- **System Context View: Library** — shows the `Patron` person (C4 stick figure) connecting to the `Library` software system with the relationship *"Browses the catalogue through (HTTPS)"*, rendered in standard C4 colors (person `#08427B`, system `#1168BD`, gray relationship arrow).

A note on how it was produced: this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Node/Graphviz and no internet access, so I couldn't run a standard renderer. Instead I parsed the workspace with the Structurizr tools, extracted the view's elements and relationships (the container-level `patron → catalog` edge is correctly aggregated to `patron → library` at the context level), and generated the SVG directly from that data. If you'd prefer PNGs, or if you can give me access to a renderer (e.g., a PlantUML server or Java), I can re-export through the official C4-PlantUML pipeline.
